source: 2013/TSB Vol 13 No 11 New Intermediate ATF Hose.pdf
title: 90 Degree Intermediate Adapter Hose for Transmission Machines
lead: MOC has developed a new 90 degree Intermediate Adapter Hose (Part No. 94855). This new Hose is especially needed to connect to transmission adapters in tight spaces where a straight connection will not fit.
body: This Hose assembly can be used with all versions of the ATF machines.
